man this weeks been rough. i need to catch a w before its over or im gonna lose it. nothing has gone right thus far. work has been just shit, got a failing grade on one of my uni submissions, classes have been just shit, group project's team vibes are foul, and im behind schedule on my submission for next friday.

i just found this this album though, which sounds p cool, don cab vibes. also finally got this site running with github. working on this has been quite fun! reminds me of when i'd spend hours on my club penguin igloo or fine tuning my mal profile. this is about as much time as i should spend on it though...

can't stop adding shit to the website, it's so much fun! need to get my uni shit done tho... wonder for how long this enthusiasm will last

album of the day

.

finally wrap up this week. been absolute shit. and i have a massive list of things to do for uni next week. future me problem. rn im just gonna chug some wine and commit n push this bitch, the one thing that has worked out this week.

happy labour day! day went ok, got done like 1.5/15 things i need to get done... on the flip side got to hang with the lads and my monitor/tablet revived! power cable got fucked, so nothing serious thankfully. drinking some wine rn and gonna add more shit to the website. crazy that i've found joy on this as something to do late at night when i dont wanna go to bed. def a great replacement for unranked. as always, album of the day

got back into reading ted chiang lately, some have been really interesting, some kinda drag, but still interesting thought experiments. i've had some thoughts lately maybe reserved to their own post. bough a bunch of art supplies for classes, bout to go to town. album of the day

finished that ted chiang book, it was pretty good. that exhalaration story was amazing.

been having a tough time at uni lately. i think im gonna fail design. have submission next week and im nowhere near there yet. i'm just not vibing with the class in general. ill try to blast photoshop this week and see where that leads me. my typography class is also pretty tough on submission but at least im having a much better time there. last design class was shit i was super tired got home past midnight and was just hating the world. that class failing feeling is creeping back, and im already regreating decisions. but alas, i'm still in this, so i guess my my only option is to see it through the bitter end.

album of the day

lots of questions, few answers. same old, same old. this week's been tough and the ones to come don't seem to be any better.

album of the day

couple days ago i finished ted chiang's exhalation, and in which there's a story about prisms, a quantic device allowing you to talk to your 'paraself', a version of you from a different timeline. basically a way to explore the what ifs of life.

the crazy part was that i had a similar experience at the same time.

for some years i had this tradition of putting out a song on my bday. as we already know this is a terrible idea. all of the things i'd put out were rushed and/or unfinished. i'd put them out bc of a sort of fomo and never went back to them.

i dont rememeber what came over me, but i decided to listen to the one i made on my 23rd bday, and it was a surreal experience. the song was exactly what i was feeling at the time, and because i was the one playing, i knew exactly what i was feeling at the time, which was the same as now. im thinking maybe ill clean it up and release it. what i made at the time was a single take recording without cutting any of the mistakes. but it'll probably be a while before that. i remember i really hated it when i posted it and never wanted to look back on it, but now i realize i was kinda cooking. crazy how that works. happened to me last week with some drawings.

alas,

song of the day

viva la patria. fuck winter. sick as a dog rn.

aside that i've been having a better time, mainly cuz i said fuck this manual shit and i'm currently making all my submission in blender. probably not gonna go well for me, but i'd rather die standing.

album of the day

another day where i wish i wasn't in this office. time for more updates ig. thinking i should've gotten into it all along.

is what i thought earlier today but i passed my graphic design assignment LETS FUCKING GOOOOOOOOOOOOOO fuck your manual shit. absolute massive W not only cuz i thought i was gonna fail for sure but because i did it my way, my fucking way, and it worked. fuck yea.

album of the day

are.na is an absolute godsent. a beatiful rabbithole of graphic resources. it truly saved my submissions. the sheer amount of resources people have gathered over time is so cool to see. entire websites dedicated to old type or magazine ads. a thing of beauty for sure. it has an app to so it gives me something more productive to do than dicking around on whatever doomscrolling app.

another update is that yesterday my main monitor that i've had for 4 years crapped out on me. it was surreal the screen started to melt superhot style into a mess of Orange pixels. it served me well, truly a shame. it also sucks that i'd probably have to throw it away, feels wrong to do so. i kinda want to get an ultrawide now but i really dont have the space for it considering i already have a second monitor. plus the ones that are reasonably priced dont go above 75hz

album of the day

today's been a day, i think. last week and a half or so have been rough man. i just dont feel like doing anything. my uni submissions are shit and are a pain to make. im tired all the time. im in the moon to escape to a hut in the woods or something. im just tired of failing every single time. i want a w for once. i think im tired that's all. i understand that good things require a lot of polishing and the only way to go is trial and error till something decent comes out but man i'd be really nice to have a 'this is good, good job'. it is true that im the type to get discouraged easily in the face of a challenge. i get frustrated easily, i hate losing but dont get fired up to not lose again. rather i get depressed and want to quit. L mentality skill issue as the kids would say. i guess this is something i should check with a therapist, but you and me know that aint happening. and by you i mean the void im typing to. on the more deeper level i dont love what im doing and it takes too much effort, which creates an imbalance of sorts. i dont know for how long imma be able to keep this pace. in hindsight it was naive of me that i'd find something i 'love', since i don't love anything in that way. cuz again, if something frustrates me then i won't love it anymore, and i get frustrated easily. it's a vicious cycle really. i must admit writing things out puts things into perspective. i should change how i input these blog entries cuz fuck writing pseudohtml is a pain lol.

i think im cursed to live in the inbetween between the idea of 'i dont like to work hard/i get frustrated and depressed easily and 'anything worth doing by definition is hard'. to be fair i think i can archieve hard things like teaching myself japanese, but only over long long periods of time, and without getting rushed. keeping the pace of a school semester has never been easy for me. maybe if i only took 1/2 classes a semester, but then again that places me in another inbetween, 'my sanity can't take more than 1/2 classes' and 'if i dont take more classes im gonna graduate in 2035'. me signing up for graphic design tried to circumvent this. the thought process was ok it's something i love (already know that's not true) and 'i'll be easy for me so i'll be chill' which is definitely not true. and that spirals into the idea of damn maybe this wasn't the most economically smart desicion to make. and also maybe i don't enjoy actively working on this, maybe i'd just leave it as a hobby. that's another idea to explore, but i can confidently say i woudln't have been able to think of such conclusions if i didn't tried, so it's not all bad.

i kinda feel better after writing this. i think im gonna take a shower and try to work on some of these things. still lots of things to think about. maybe that's how it'll always be, and having things 'figured out' is not a possibility for me. maybe im made to ride a forever wave of anxiety and uncertanty.

album of the day

i didn't realize a side effect of understanding japanese is that depressing japanese songs actually have depressing lyrics and i can actually understand them and get depressed too FUCK
